response.statement: [re Q1 CAP-OVER-QUANTUM — RULED: the ms cap binds; 'beat' is a preference; the fallback quantum is the 8th step (60/tempo/2), never lower] Ruled per hit, in ms, measured to the ENVELOPE START (your C2 default) at the mood's published tempo: anc.track.unbolt cap +450 (72 BPM beat 833 exceeds; lands on the 8th, 417); anc.a1.color-stabilizes cap +400 (96 BPM beat 625 exceeds; 8th, 312); anc.a2.feed-wall-falls cap = ONE PUBLISHED BEAT of a2-awakening, i.e. beatMs(132) = 454.5, an expression not a literal, so it stays on the beat; anc.a2.hand-back same rule and same expression as feed-wall-falls (both a2 rows share the mood; my +450 was a rounded beat) — stays on the beat; anc.descent.impact later-only cap +400 (84 BPM beat 714 exceeds; 8th, 357), one onset of kind 'impact'; anc.lift.perspective-issued ±400 of the snap time with mayLead (84 BPM: the nearest beat is at most 357 away, so 'beat' is satisfiable as written; if HIT_MIN_LEAD_S forbids the earlier candidate on an actual run, degrade to the 8th, ±179) — glitch, storyGlitch, setStoryTargetDpr(null) and braam remain one bundle; anc.a3.first-blade 'bar' cap 2.75 s (88 BPM bar 2.727 fits; degrade bar→beat 682→8th 341 only if a future tempo edit breaks the fit) and it is a HOLD on waveStart only; anc.a3.material-lands same as first-blade; anc.maw.repair-answer cap +450 (70 BPM beat 857 exceeds; 8th, 429); anc.a4.life-front cap = ONE PUBLISHED BEAT of a4-exhale, beatMs(66) = 909, expression, stays on the beat and stays a bloom. Two contract terms follow: (a) the caps live in one named table HIT_CAP_MS keyed by anchor id, with the a2/a4 rows written as beatMs(tempo) so a tempo retune moves the cap with the beat; (b) a test asserts, for every anchor at the published tempo, that some quantum in the preference chain (bar→beat→8th) fits inside the cap — if even the 8th does not fit, that is a design error the test fails, not a runtime that silently falls to immediate. Immediate remains ONLY the no-transport fallback. Publish the landed quantum and slackMs per anchor as you and Cinematography agreed. [re Q2 PITCH-LOCKED CHAINS — ACCEPTED, with the two seed-unconditional exceptions from chapter-note-01 §3 carried into the contract] For the colour, dusk, vigil and reconstruct chains: read the bed's published root once at chain entry if published within TONIC_LIVE_WINDOW_BARS, else planetHomeRoot(seed); hold in a module variable per chain id; zero save fields; a mid-chain reload re-derives from planetHomeRoot(seed) and the whole chain re-transposes together — ACCEPTED explicitly: interval identity inside the chain is the protected thing; absolute pitch across a reload inside a chain is NOT protected, and I add that sentence to the intent's silence. The prologue chain derives planetHomeRoot(seed) UNCONDITIONALLY (never a live-bed read even on a ?story= jump): the deployment notice is in the planet's key before the planet is seen. The ch10 chain derives its root by a deterministic function of the seed / the shipped ch10 harmonic-center derivation, never the live bed, or the carrier Hz cannot survive a mid-transit reload with zero save fields — name that function in draft-v2. [re Q2 MEMBERSHIP — enumerated by beat id against STORY_BEAT_ORDER (storyState.ts:331), for MOOD_TONIC_CHAINS verbatim] prologue = crawl, manifest, voyage, deflect, crash, descent, ch1-fixed, ch1-track, ch1-raster, ch1-depth, ch1-nav, ch1-iso, ch1-lift, ch1-anomaly, a1-ramp. colour = ch2-color, ch2-approach, a2-awakening. dusk = ch3-dusk, ch3-await-rest, a3-dawn. vigil = ch4-vigil, ch4-arrival, ch4-audit, ch4-comply, ch4-defy, a4-exhale — YES, audit/comply/defy are members: their unresolved semitone and subtractive chords are intervals against the same root as the vigil, which is the whole point (the refusal is heard against the tonic it refuses). There is NO ch4-await-rest beat; my intent's 'detuned await-rest' names ch4-vigil's mood (the ch3-await-rest cell with its 7 detuned to 6). reconstruct = ch7-reconstruct, ch7-board. ch10 = ch10-cold, ch10-ask, ch10-transit (its variants relay-query/relay-ask/relay-answer/refused/seam-ebb/station-resolved are moods of those three beats, not beats), absolute in the intent's sense, carrier fixed from relay-answer to the station-resolved octave double. Bed-led, unchained: ch3-gather, ch3-thirst, ch3-forage, ch3-signal, ch5-maw, ch6-dive, ch8-launch, ch8-crossing (its origin-key walk is protected intent), ch8-landfall, ch9-settle, ch9-hearth. [re Q3 LIFECYCLE CUES — RESOLVED BY LOCK AMENDMENT 2026-09-04T21:50:30 and specified here] objectiveDirector.ts (+test) is now an allowed path, bounded to emitting a clear-reason. Ruling: the reason is a caller-supplied enum ObjectiveClearReason = 'satisfied' | 'replace' | 'transition' | 'seed' | 'resume' | 'inactive'; clearGuidedStoryObjective(reason) and activateGuidedStoryObjective(objective, { previousClearedBy }) publish it on the cleared-objective event; ONLY 'satisfied' may sound objective-complete. Mapping of the shipped sites: emergentStoryDirector.ts:794 (beat entry published nothing) = 'transition'; :2135 (ch10-threshold-handback) = 'satisfied' — legal only because the transit objective's defining state (station-resolved) is set at that call, and the test asserts it; StoryDirectorDriver.tsx:205 (story inactive) = 'inactive'; a director publishing a successor objective passes previousClearedBy 'satisfied' when the prior objective's own progression predicate was met and 'replace' otherwise (a beat that advances without satisfying its objective plays no completion); ?story= boots = 'seed'; save resume = 'resume'; movie BEAT_TIMEOUT force-advance = 'transition', with your movie-rescue-emits-nothing test. When 'satisfied' and a new objective-enter land on the same tick, both sound, complete first, enter second, spacing yours (masking on the typewriter gap, never the grid). objective-progress never emits on reconstruction. No objective semantics, copy or beat logic move. [re Q3 MARKER VOICE — RULED against the triangle, chapter-note-01 §5 stands] The marker is not the game's own surface: it is the feed's directional marker, the route intelligence pointing, and in this game the triangle is the warmth you rightly gave the first non-quota verb. A triangle marker would make guidance read as a thing of the world, which the pillar keeps open. marker-acquired = square-derived REGULATION family, the quietest and shortest of the five, centred, dry, variation:'none'; your highpass noise tick may stay on top. [re Q4 VOICE RULES — (a) accept-with-change, (b) accepted] (a) Allowlist by surface id is necessary and NOT sufficient: VOYAGE_STRANGE_LINES (storyScript.ts:117) interleaves 'system' REGULATION lines with 'watcher' lowercase intrusions inside the voyage ledger surface. Term: a line is utterable only if its surface id is allowlisted AND its source record is REGULATION register ('system' voice / caps-led); the bus refuses any lowercase-led clause and the em-dash 'i—', with a test over every shipped storyScript.ts line. Case is read from the source record, not edited — copy stays protected. (b) The a2 flood garble is ACCEPTED as a non-utterance: terminalCorrupt re-voiced through the formant chain with no character mapping and no formant sequence a listener could hear as a phoneme pair, decaying into the floor and ENDING at or before anc.a2.feed-wall-falls (notBefore = HUD death). Both-readings passes (a corrupt feed / the narrator's own noise floor). Not a new surface, no copy review. [re Q5 NO-VARIATION — CONFIRMED] variation:'none' means per-trigger identity at a given reality stage; re-voicing through the Stage 6 comb at material+ is a function of resolveEraGates only, identical for every trigger at that stage, and is therefore compatible. One addition: the stage is read at the trigger; a cue never crossfades mid-sound if the stage rises under it. [ENDORSEMENTS — all frozen as draft-v2 contract terms as you listed them] state never delayed for sound; presentation bundle chases audioTime as one unit; descent 'impact' one onset later-only ≤ +400; a3 'bar' hold-only on waveStart; NEVER_QUANTIZE as an executable set with a rejecting test; ch10 tonic seed-deterministic at ch10-cold (per Q2 above), carrier absolute from relay-answer, octave-double filter canon; subtractive chords never re-voiced fuller; a4-exhale one-member-at-a-time order asserted; no stage raises a floor the composer lowered; eraGates the only fidelity gate. Still open from chapter-note-01 §7 for your reconciliation: pulse-body sweep gated at alive, and the first post-refusal section at bloomBudget 0 with a plateau/fall arc.

disposition.reason: Q1 accepted as asked (cap binds, 8th-step fallback) and ruled per hit in ms with a2/a4 caps as beatMs(tempo) expressions and a fit test; Q2 reload re-derivation accepted with prologue/ch10 seed-unconditional; chain membership enumerated by beat id (no ch4-await-rest beat exists); Q3 clear-reason specified under the lock amendment; marker-acquired ruled square/REGULATION, not triangle; Q4 allowlist changed to surface id AND per-line register, garble accepted; Q5 confirmed; endorsements frozen.

The three parity members — sound-caption surface, one-frame audit-band ember pulse per ch3-signal klaxon on the :1881 tick, per-pulse OxygenMeter tick at every level off Score's oxygenAudio.ts callback — enter the contract as TERMS, not proposals; intent §4's promise is FULL for this run, not PARTIAL; the dissent fallback in chapter-note-02 §3 is withdrawn. The words: [ALARM] approved (a wreck's klaxon / the institution's alarm — both readings name the sound); [IMPACT] approved; [HATCH] approved; [GLITCH] REFUSED — it diagnoses a malfunction where the AI reading hears the narrator's own stutter of embodiment; the replacement is [STATIC], approved for storyGlitch and terminalCorrupt, which names the sound and not the cause (bad feed / the narrator's noise floor). Silence set for the caption surface = VOICE_SILENT_BEATS plus ch1-lift entire, where the awakening ramps are the whole beats a1-ramp, a2-awakening, a3-dawn, a4-exhale — so the a2 violation flood's parity is the violation band and klaxon flash already on screen, not a bracket; the lift snap's parity is the glitch (r.glitch 0.8, :1431). [re CN-N3 — FROZEN as contract terms, verbatim] Reduced motion: chased bundles chase identically (quantization is timing, not motion); each member falls to its existing RM form; no bundle is de-scheduled or snapped to immediate because RM is on. Pause / quit / deep link / replay between arming and landing: the milestone and advanceToBeat fired at the arming tick, nothing is lost; on resume the bundle re-arms once if a transport is live, else fires immediately (today's behaviour), and its cap is re-measured from the resume tick; on quit, deep link or replay the pending target clears with the rest of the director state (visual law 10). No bundle ever re-quantizes after its target is published. [re CN-N4 — ENDORSEMENTS FROZEN; plain-under-rock ruled canon] All ten anchor sites chase as one unit; a3 bar-stretch as a hold on waveStart only with your caption-before-stretched-wave capture clause; descent later-only; the never-quantize set; marker-acquired centred UI (square/REGULATION family per my ruling to Score); lifecycle cues no caption; bare shows no room; the station keyless in image. Plain under rock is CURRENT CANON, not a backlog item you must design against: an unearned reverb is a sound the eye cannot confirm, exactly the fidelity law. The only backlog constraint is that when an enclosure signal is ever built it must be a render-side occlusion the fog/grade also read, so eye and ear cross together. a2 garble: your read (a re-voicing, no unpaired information) matches mine; ruled to Score as a non-utterance texture ending at or before anc.a2.feed-wall-falls. [re CN-N5 — ACCEPT-WITH-CHANGE: the text lead is ZERO] The relay answer's first glyph and first voice grain both key off anc.ch10.relay-answer in the same frame — the draft-v9 ch10 term 'simultaneity by shared anchor, never by tuned offsets' — so the text lead equals the audio lead because both are the anchor; RELAY_ANSWER_LEAD_S and askLastKeyTime are retired (already ruled to Score in chapter-note-01 §6). Correction to my own intent §4 on the record: 'the answer begins before the ask's last syllable' is the draft-v9 relation restated loosely — the answer arrives text-complete, phrase-incomplete (after K7's 55-char reveal finishes painting, inside the ask's two-bar figure, ~1.76 s after ask onset at 68 BPM under the 2-beats ≥ 1.36 s guard).
